verdict.rationale: Ultrametric does ship agent skills: `ultrametric init` writes SKILL.md files for Codex and Claude Code, and `--dry-run` previews which files it will create. However, nothing in the evidence shows what those skills say they do or what triggers their activation. The dry-run file preview and the option to commit skill files are adjacent controls, not per-skill documentation of behavior and activation, so they earn no credit toward this story.
